sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.6998 of 2024
Order:

This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...pleased to issue a writ, order or direction, more particularly, one in the nature of WRIT OF MANDAMUS, declaring the action of the respondent No.2 in forwarding the application of petitioners dated 05/06/2023, requesting for permission to mortgage their land to an extent of Ac.04- 37 guntas in Sy No. 97/B and Ac.08. 020 gts., in Sy. No. 110/C situated in Hadnoor Village of Nyalkal Mandal, Sangareddy District with the Scheduled Bank, while the acquisition proceedings dated 26/09/2020 initiated u/s 11(1) of Act 30 of 2013 are pending, and the subsequent action of Respondent No. 4 in issuing endorsement dated 20.02.2024, rejecting the request of petitioners for permission to mortgage their subject lands as illegal,
unconstitutional and without the authority and consequently set aside the impugned endorsement letter dated 20/02/2024, while directing the respondent No.2 herein to expeditiously consider the application of the petitioners afresh as per law and pass..."
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition for the respondents and perused the record.
With the consent of both sides, this writ petition is disposed of at the stage of admission itself.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are having lands situated at Hadnoor Village of Nyalkal Mandal and Sangareddy District.
The lands of the petitioners along with other lands were proposed for the 2 SK, J W.P.No.6998 oF 2024 establishment of National Investment and Manufacturing Zone (NIMZ), Zaheerabad.
The respondents issued Preliminary Notification on 26.09.2020.

Thereafter, the petitioners submitted a application dated 05.06.2023,
requesting respondent No.2 to grant permission for mortgaging their lands.
The respondent No.2 forwarded the application made by the petitioners to the respondent No.4 for taking necessary action.
Thereafter, the respondent No.4 has rejected the application/request made by the petitioners and issued impugned orders on 20.02.2024 without assigning any reason.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners further submits that as per Section 11(4) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013,
the respondent No.2-District Collector in special circumstances may allow the application submitted by the owners of the lands despite the lands are notified.
5.

sentences.text:
In the instant case, the petitioners submitted application to the respondent No.2-District Collector on 05.06.2023 i.e., after issuing 4(1) notification on 26.09.2020,
requesting the respondent No.2-District Collector to grant permission for mortgaging the petitioners land.
The respondent No.2 without passing any orders on the application submitted by the petitioners forwarded the same to the respondent No.4 for taking further action.

The 4 SK, J W.P.No.6998 oF 2024 respondent No.4 without giving any specific reason rejected the application of the petitioners on 20.02.2024.
7.

The petitioners in their representation dated 05.06.2023 specifically mentioned that the respondent No.2 in similar circumstances, granted permission for mortgaging the lands in Sy.No.237 situated in Reginthal Village of Nalkal Mandal on 22.01.2022.

In the instant case the respondent No.2 being a competent authority and without passing any orders as per Section 11 (4)
of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, forwarded the application of the petitioners to the respondent No.4.

sentences.text: The respondent No.4 without considering the application of the petitioners passed impugned endorsement and the same is arbitrary and illegal.
In view of the same, the impugned endorsement is liable to be set aside.

8. In view of the above findings, the writ petition is disposed of by setting aside the endorsement dated 20.02.2024 issued by the respondent No.4 and directing the respondent No.2 to consider the application submitted by the petitioners on 05.06.2023 and pass appropriate orders as per Section 11(4) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and 5 SK, J W.P.No.6998 oF 2024 Resettlement Act, 2013, within a period of two (02) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
